rows.name: Restore open tabs on launch
rows.body: Reopens the query tabs you had open last time. Turn it off if your query text is sensitive — the tabs are stored in plain text.

rows.name: Query timeout
rows.body: Cancels a query still running after this long. Set it to 0 for no limit.

rows.name: Vault file path
rows.body: Where the encrypted vault lives — point it at an encrypted drive if you like. Must include the filename. Changing it locks the current vault; the file at the new path has its own master password, and one is created if nothing is there yet.

rows.name: Change master password
rows.body: Re-encrypts the vault key under a new password and deletes the previous backup file, which is still readable with the old password.

rows.name: Auto-lock
rows.body: Re-locks the vault and closes every open connection after this much inactivity. It tracks app activity rather than mouse movement, so a long query is never interrupted by its own timer.
